text:
Alex: Heads up — private-vpc customer hitting 3x tail latency starting ~2024-11-12 10:04 UTC after the batch-heuristics tweak we rolled last night. Repro on staging, digging in now.
Priya: Ugh. Which heuristic change? small-batch favoring dynamic kernel selection? @alex can you paste the trace?
Alex: Yeah we flipped `prefer_small_batch_v2` -> true. Trace from staging agent:
```
[2024-11-12T10:04:12Z] req_id=9d2 kernel_select=soft_sched_v2 batch_size=4 queue_len=62 egress_if=eni-7f3a
[2024-11-12T10:04:12Z] cpu_ms=12 syscall_ctx_switches=23 kvm_miss=0
[2024-11-12T10:04:12Z] tail_latency_ms=87
```
Earlier `fastpath-v1` had tail 28ms for same workload.
Ben: Also seeing bursty SNAT ephemeral port churn on the host (same ENI). Could be port reuse + kernel choice increasing syscalls -> slow path. `ss -s` shows many TIME_WAIT.
Chen: PCAP snippet from egress interface (filtered):
```
> 10:04:12.513 TCP 10.0.2.45:51234 -> 52.23.11.5:443 [SYN]
> 10:04:12.513 TCP 52.23.11.5:443 -> 10.0.2.45:51234 [RST]
> 10:04:12.514 TCP 10.0.2.45:51235 -> 52.23.11.5:443 [SYN]
```
lots of short lived ports, and SYN/RST pattern.
Priya: Could firewall or egress routing be causing hairpin + extra NAT lookups? Any recent security group or route changes for that VPC?
Alex: No config changes on security groups. Only change was the batching heuristic + kernel selector fallback order (we allowed `soft_sched_v2` to be selected for batches <8). Staging hosts are co-located with other tenants too.
Ben: Host metrics show CPU softirq jumps and `runqueue` spikes coincident with tail latency. Suggest noisy neighbor + kernel path causing more context switches.
Chen: I ran `tc -s qdisc show dev eth0` and saw massive drops/overlimits on the default qdisc; egress qlen bouncing at 1000 then clearing. Might be intermittent queueing before NAT layer.
Alex: Quick mitigation: pin kernel selector on staging/private to `fastpath-v1` and revert prefer_small_batch_v2 flag. Anyone object to immediate rollback on prod-reserved customer? :thinking:
Priya: rollback looks safe. That vendor kernel had better tail P95 across multiple runs.
Ben: I can run a targeted rollback on the affected pool now. Will update deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollback-batching-heuristic to staging pool (rollout 5%).
Alex: After 5% rollback in staging tail latency dropped back to ~30ms within 90s. Looks like kernel selector + batching interaction + egress port churn.
Chen: Follow-ups:
- add instrumentation: count kernel_fallback events by egress_if
- expose SNAT ephemeral port usage in Console for private VPC customers
- add a safety check: if SNAT ephemeral usage > 70% avoid soft_sched_v2
Priya: Agreed. Also add a short-circuit: small batches to `fastpath-v1` for ENIs with >50 conn/s until we root cause.
Ben: I'll open a perf-investigation ticket and attach the traces + host pcaps. Marking as P1 for this customer.
Alex: Thanks team — will monitor prod after full rollback. If anyone sees a regression after changelet re-deploy, ping here.
Chen: Filed ticket INFRA-1129 with logs and pcap link. Attaching `tc -s` and `ss -s` snapshots.
Ben: Noting that this looks different from previous conntrack saturation—here it's a kernel scheduling choice that amplified ephemeral churn. Need long-term: smarter kernel-selection model that factors ephemeral port pressure.
Alex: Good notes. Closing the thread once post-rollout 24h stable. :thumbsup:
